verdict.rationale: Shortcut documents its own built-in automations that act on events: Epics auto-start and auto-complete, future Iterations are auto-created, and unfinished Stories roll over to the next Iteration. These are fixed, predefined behaviors, though, not a user-defined rule engine where you choose triggers and actions. The REST API is only a building block and earns no credit. Missing for 10: user-configurable trigger/condition/action rules, a documented list of supported event types, AI-native rule authoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Auto-start and auto-complete an Epic, auto-create future Iterations, and move unfinished Stories to the next Iteration
